records.name: Antigravity Remote Control
records.tagline: Drive Antigravity agents from any browser
records.description: Antigravity Remote Control lets you monitor and drive Antigravity coding sessions from any web browser. Keep full local context, credentials, and build tools on your primary workstation while reviewing plans, approving commands, and receiving push alerts on the go.

records.name: Wavepocket ▶︎•၊||၊||။၊|။
records.tagline: Synth, drum kit, a 4-track tape loop, and FX app
records.description: Wavepocket is a pocket studio: a synthesizer, drum kit, sampler and 4-track tape recorder that fit in your hand. Slice samples on the waveform, name each slice, and flip between them 4-track tape with a clip timeline: record in any mode, then drag clips between lanes, trim their edges, and cut at the playhead. Everything shares one loop boundary, so your layers always line up. Mixer with per-track level, pan and mute

records.name: Treebar
records.tagline: Treebar gives you one view of every active worktree
records.description: Codex working across 5 worktrees? Treebar shows you where it is, what’s changing, and how many agents are working, all from your MacBook notch. Treebar watches Git and Codex, to see where and what it's working on. Made this months ago because I kept losing track of where Codex was working. Finally decided to ship it. I’m also open sourcing the core soon.

records.name: WorldMap.lol
records.tagline: Put your startup on the map. Literally.
records.description: A public map where startups stake countries. A fun way to compete with out founders/indie hackers.

records.name: Contrive
records.tagline: Search and act across all your work apps
records.description: Contrive is a unified search and action layer for company knowledge. It doesn’t just return links: it synthesizes context across connected tools, preserves source traceability, and turns results into immediate actions all from a keyboard-first desktop command bar. Unlike search only products or generic AI assistants, Contrive closes the gap between finding and doing, while respecting workspace permissions and giving teams precise control over what gets indexed.

records.name: IFAH
records.tagline: Instruments for composing and experiencing sound as a space
records.description: IFAH is a new family of instruments built around a simple idea: sound can be composed as an environment. Create, preserve and replay reproducible acoustic fields for listening, practice, performance and research. IFAH combines offline-first instruments, sealed acoustic experiences and new interfaces for interacting with sound from carefully composed fields to playing music with your hands.

records.name: Lucid Train
records.tagline: Build system design for new and existing codebase
records.description: Lucid Train generates architecture diagrams from your codebase, then hands the diagram to a coding agent as a specification. Local models, fully offline.

records.name: Dropstone
records.tagline: The AI runtime that remembers, learns, and acts everywhere
records.description: Dropstone is a runtime for intelligence, one system that can evolve from an AI assistant into an always-on digital workforce.

records.name: Phoenix
records.tagline: AI coding agent built for iOS, macOS app development
records.description: Phoenix is an AI coding agent built specifically for iOS development. It writes and edits code, runs builds and tools, diagnoses errors, and helps you take an iOS project from idea to working app.

records.name: Offloop
records.tagline: A shared workspace where people and AI agents get work done
records.description: Offloop is a shared workspace where teammates and AI agents plan, execute, and track multi-step work together. Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.

records.name: Decawork
records.tagline: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools
records.description: Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

records.name: Navigara
records.tagline: Connect Your AI Spend Directly to Your Roadmap
records.description: Navigara connects AI coding performance directly to your engineering roadmap. Analyzing code like a senior engineer to prove real capacity gains, Navigara tracks exact costs per roadmap item, isolates off-roadmap waste, and identifies maintenance burn. Cut spend further by automatically routing routine CRUD tasks to low-cost models without sacrificing quality. Connects in minutes via Git history, JIRA/Linear, and any AI coding license for spend.

records.name: Cortex by SKYNETLAB
records.tagline: The memory layer that decides what's worth remembering
records.description: Hosted semantic memory your AI connects to over MCP. Every write passes a quality gate (~80% rejected as redundant in production), facts become typed claims, contradictions are tracked instead of overwritten, and answers cite their sources. 2-minute setup with Claude, works with any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no card. Plans from €0.99/month. EU infrastructure, patent-pending engine. Built solo in Bergamo, Italy.

records.name: Trama
records.tagline: Create macOS native automations using plain language
records.description: Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

records.name: Destiny Rings
records.tagline: Proximity-powered dating, social & networking
records.description: Destiny Rings replaces endless swiping with real-world proximity. Wear a Bluetooth-enabled smart ring, and when someone compatible is nearby — at a bar, an event, walking down the street — the app lets you know. Choose Dating, Social, or Networking mode depending on what you're looking for, send a Signal, run a quick Fate Check, then tap to reveal and start talking in person. No profiles to scroll, no matching from miles away. Just real chemistry with people who are actually in the room.

records.name: PaymentKit
records.tagline: Billing that survives a processor shutdown
records.description: PaymentKit is a multi-processor billing platform for SaaS and e-commerce. It routes payments across processors, vaults tokens independently, and keeps subscriptions billing even if a MID gets shut down. No code to launch, full API when you need it.

records.name: Localdock
records.tagline: Every local project gets a real address.
records.description: Localdock provides a simple solution for accessing local projects with a real HTTPS link. It allows you to share your development environment without any installation required on the client side. With a one-time payment of $9, you can manage your projects easily and access them from anywhere, even on mobile devices.

records.name: Bumply
records.tagline: Update your dependencies and undo anything
records.description: A Mac app for keeping npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun projects current. Bumply shows you every command before it runs, backs up your manifest and lockfile byte-for-byte, and rolls back the moment anything fails.

records.name: KiftMe
records.tagline: A prepaid recommendation app
records.description: KiftMe turns word-of-mouth into prepaid recommendations. Instead of simply telling someone about a book, meal, film or experience you loved, you can prepay part or all of that exact experience for them. They receive a personal recommendation with a real nudge to act, not a generic gift card. If they don’t use it, the money is refunded. For businesses, KiftMe converts happy customers’ recommendations into measurable new customers.

records.name: Trilo3D
records.tagline: Turn photos into textured 3D models online
records.description: Turn one image or multi-view photos into textured 3D models online. Export GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, or STL with up to 2M-face geometry and PBR materials.

records.name: sayso.lol
records.tagline: Pay to change what the internet says.
records.description: sayso.lol is a live internet argument with one statement, one answer, and one clock. Disagree with the answer? Pay to replace it. The first change costs $1, and the price goes up every time someone changes it. Your answer stays until someone pays to replace it or the clock runs out. Every paid answer is permanently recorded on the board. No voting. No likes. No winner. Just one answer — and whoever cares enough to change it.

records.name: AI Startup Founder OS
records.tagline: The AI-powered operating system for startup founders
records.description: AI Startup Founder OS is a complete operating system for early-stage founders to plan, validate, and build startups faster. Unlike scattered templates and random tools, it combines AI-powered prompts, startup frameworks, and practical templates in one system. Includes: 🚀 Startup strategy tools 🤖 AI founder prompts 📊 Product roadmap 💰 Investor CRM 📈 Growth planning 💵 Finance tracking Built for founders turning ideas into real businesses. Looking for feedback from the founder community.

records.name: SubReady
records.tagline: Subscription Tracker
records.description: Track every subscription. Never miss a renewal. SubReady helps you keep every recurring subscription in one clear place. Add streaming services, apps, memberships, storage plans, and any recurring expense. See what is due next, understand your monthly and yearly spending, and get reminders before renewal dates.

records.name: Todo Agents
records.tagline: simply create a todos for you and your agent
records.description: Stop feeding your coding agent one prompt at a time. Queue up tasks as you go through your app for review — your agent picks up over a simple REST API and reports back on every task. Easy to working with your non-technical team mate, QA, designer and PO with project based permission.

records.name: BypassGPTs
records.tagline: AI Humanizer To Bypass AI Detection
records.description: Most tools stop at a one-click rewrite. BypassGPTs brings the full post-draft workflow into one place: humanize AI text, detect common AI patterns, paraphrase awkward sections, fix grammar, create social content and track word counts. Its contextual rewriting preserves the original meaning while improving tone, rhythm and readability. Instead of chasing a detector score alone, it helps users create writing they feel confident publishing.

records.name: Text Snap Desktop

Includes Spacebar QuickLook peeking with click-to-copy, 1-click Table-to-CSV extraction, clean code formatting without line numbers, privacy redaction shields, and floating Pin-to-Screen HUD (Alt+P). Zero cloud servers, zero latency, pay once and own forever.

records.name: MTL Exits

Teams connect a cloud account, stand up infrastructure, see architecture and estimated cost, catch drift, and run change through review, approval, and audit without a different toolchain per cloud.

records.name: ToolMintX

The latest release adds an AI VRAM Calculator, support for newer AI models, and expanded utilities built to make everyday tasks faster and simpler.

records.name: CardWarden: Family Card Wallet

Android beta remains open while waiting for approval on the Play Store. Built for households who stack gift cards and still want privacy.

records.name: PulseBot
records.tagline: AI product feedback intelligence for SaaS teams

records.name: GEOCARA

Say goodbye to boilerplate code and leverage AI orchestration for smarter app development.

records.name: Antigravity Remote Control

records.name: Colour Name Finder
records.tagline: find any colour’s name and HEX code in seconds.
records.description: Free online Colour Name Finder tool. Use our hex color name finder by hex code or image, extract palettes, and explore color name classifications offline.

records.name: MonkeyLock
records.tagline: Your phone locks your apps until you do push-ups
records.description: MonkeyLock blocks the apps you choose using Apple's Screen Time. When your minutes run out they lock, and you get them back by doing push-ups — the front camera counts the reps on device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. The part I think is actually new: adding an app to the wall is instant, but taking one off waits until the next morning. Every blocker I tried could be undone in ten seconds, which is exactly when it was working. Free. No subscription, no ads, no account.

records.name: Ladder
records.tagline: The public leaderboard for websites and products.

No hidden score. Just a readable public experiment in attention and discovery.internet. Watch the board move.

records.name: Contexter
records.tagline: One context for every AI — and everyone you work with
records.description: Collect thoughts and materials from Telegram, group chats, ChatGPT, and Claude into a single context. Share it, build on it together, and work with it using your preferred AI. Architecture notes, backlogs, work logs, raw ideas, tickets, or a travel itinerary—the format doesn’t matter; the accumulated meaning does. Ask an LLM, and it turns that context into a summary, a decision history, or next steps. Now early access.

records.name: Better Bginfo

records.name: MedRank CBT
records.tagline: Real exam-like CBT tests + AI tutor for NEET PG aspirants
records.description: MedRank CBT is a mock test platform built for NEET PG aspirants who want real exam-like practice, not another MCQ dump. 🎯 Full-length CBT mocks with real exam timing & sectional structure 🤖 AI tutor for instant doubt-solving 📊 AIR predictor based on historical data 🔓 Score-based paper unlocking 📚 15,000+ clinical vignette MCQs Built to feel like exam day, every day you practice.

records.name: DeepStories
records.tagline: Watch and create films made entirely with AI
records.description: DeepStories is a platform built entirely for AI-generated cinema — films, series, and short films made by real creators, not studios. Browse AI Originals across genres, discover new creators, track what you're watching, and if you make AI films yourself, publish them with a real audience and community behind them.

records.name: The World of Online Earnings
records.tagline: Your Guide to Legit Online Earning Platforms & Opportunities
records.description: The World of Online Earnings is an independent resource for discovering, researching and comparing online earning platforms, digital businesses, SaaS products and other opportunities available on the internet. We go beyond simple “make money online” claims by looking at how platforms actually work, their earning opportunities, pricing, credibility, practical challenges, limitations and user experience. No hype. No unrealistic income promises. Just practical research, reviews and insights.

records.name: MyAssets
records.tagline: Track every asset and simulate your future net worth
records.description: MyAssets is a privacy-first asset tracker for iOS. Add your cash, stocks, mutual funds, bonds, and crypto across multiple currencies to see your full net worth in one place — no bank account linking required, ever. ✨ Multi-currency support, daily change at a glance ✨ Simulate future net worth (bear/standard/bull) ✨ CSV export · 7 languages supported ✨ All data stays on your device Free to use, with an optional ad-free Premium plan for unlimited assets and full simulation history.

records.name: Destiny Installers
records.tagline: Dstv installation, Dstv Technicians, Dstv Installers
records.description: Dstv Installation Multichoice & All Surrounding Areas. Call [hidden information]. And Enjoy the Best Dstv has to Offer! Installations and Inspection Services Explora 1, 2, 3, Ultra/4 DSTV Installations TV Link Eye- USB Smart Remote Blasters 90cm Satellite Dish Extra Points Hd Pvr/Standard Decoder HDMI Extender over Cat6/Cat6a Extraview/Trippleview Cat6/ Cat7 Cable Networking Installation Communal Installation OVHD Installation DStv Installer Near Me CCTV Installation Mu Dstv Coaxial Cable Repair

records.name: SQL Change Guard
records.tagline: Governance Before Execution, Confidence in Production.
records.description: SQL Change Guard connects every script and production data request on SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle to automated approvals, risk analysis, and immutable audit logs. No script runs without approval, no sensitive data is delivered unmasked, and all audit evidence is collected in a single sealed dossier.

records.name: Trama
records.tagline: Create macOS native automations using plain language
records.description: Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

records.name: Cortex by SKYNETLAB
records.tagline: The memory layer that decides what's worth remembering
records.description: Hosted semantic memory your AI connects to over MCP. Every write passes a quality gate (~80% rejected as redundant in production), facts become typed claims, contradictions are tracked instead of overwritten, and answers cite their sources. 2-minute setup with Claude, works with any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no card. Plans from €0.99/month. EU infrastructure, patent-pending engine. Built solo in Bergamo, Italy.

records.name: ByteTools API Directory
records.tagline: 2,227 free APIs, 768 with curl examples that really ran
records.description: Most public-API lists copy their examples from a README that stopped working years ago. This one runs on one rule: on the 768 fully documented pages, the curl command and the JSON response are the real request and the real reply, and each page carries the date it was run. A verifier script re-hits all 768 endpoints in CI so the claim doesn't quietly rot. 2,227 APIs catalogued across 26 categories, 963 of which need no API key at all. No signup, no key of mine in the middle.

records.name: Almond Monitor — Monitoring the cool way
records.tagline: Monitoring tool bridging Nagios and OTEL
records.description: Almond Monitor - monitoring API with Nagios plugins, including metrics, OTEL exporter and Kafka producer capabilities.

records.name: Hyper Search & Filter
records.tagline: AI Search and Product Filters for Shopify Stores
records.description: Add AI search, instant suggestions, typo tolerance, collection filters, synonyms and merchandising controls to Shopify. Install Hyper Search & Filter free.

records.name: Tabby
records.tagline: A cat that lives in your browser (Chrome extension)
records.description: A free Chrome extension. Pet her, feed her, and watch her grow from kitten to adult. Private, local, and free.

records.name: Amalgama Online
records.tagline: AI workflow automation that fits the way your business works
records.description: Amalgama designs, tests, and implements practical AI workflow automation for operations, research, support, sales, and internal knowledge. Our delivery experience comes from major banks, oil and gas and three global IT integrators, plus consulting in Big Three and Big Four environments. Previously, we've have built three businesses of our own and exited two. We know which processes survive automation and which quietly break, so we prototype against your real workflow before anyone commits.

records.name: Open Grill Cabin
records.tagline: Luxury Outdoor Living and Wellness Products
records.description: Create the perfect space for outdoor cooking, entertaining, and relaxing with our Open Grill Cabin. Designed for year-round use, it blends rustic charm with modern functionality, a cosy gathering spot for family and friends in any season. Ideal for hosting unforgettable garden parties, sharing smoky, flavourful meals, and enjoying peaceful moments, it becomes the heart of your outdoor space where laughter, connection, and relaxation come naturally.

records.name: Codity
records.tagline: Radically Different Codebase Intelligence
records.description: One connected platform where every review, commit, ticket, security finding, and production outage continuously improves a shared, persistent understanding of your codebase. Most products analyze each task in isolation. Their context disappears when the session ends. Codity’s intelligence compounds over time. Codity doesn’t simply observe your software. It learns from its entire lifecycle and turns that knowledge into better decisions every day.

records.name: Ad Blocker For All Browser
records.tagline: One tap to block ads, trackers, and malicious domains
records.description: Most iOS ad blockers only work in Safari. Open a link inside Instagram or Reddit and the ads are back. Ad Blocker works at three layers: Safari content blocking, DNS-level filtering that stops ads and trackers across every app on your device, and a built-in private browser with strict tracker protection. It also blocks known malicious domains and shows a live counter of what's been blocked, so you can see it working. No account, no login. Two toggles, under a minute.

records.name: NewsBolts
records.tagline: HUMAN-GOVERNED AI NEWSROOM OPERATING SYSTEM
records.description: NewsBolts is an AI-powered newsroom infrastructure platform that helps publishers automate news research, article writing, SEO optimization, publishing, analytics, and content distribution at scale.

records.name: Local Photo Restore
records.tagline: Make old family photos clearer, privately on your iPhone
records.description: Local Photo Restore improves clarity and resolution in old, faded, yellowed, or low-resolution family photos without uploading them. Choose a photo or photograph a print, enhance it, adjust yellow tint and faded existing color, compare before and after, and save a new copy. The original stays untouched. There is no account, photo-processing server, advertising, analytics, or third-party tracking. This first release does not colorize black-and-white photos or reconstruct scratches and damage.

records.name: The Most Powerful Notion Life Planner
records.tagline: The Most Powerful Notion Life Planner Ever Created
records.description: WHAT'S INSIDE 🌟 North Star & Vision 🎯 Annual Goals Ledger 📈 Quarterly Objectives 🗓️ Monthly Overview 📋 Weekly Spread ☀️ Daily Log ✅ Habit Tracker 💰 Wheel of Life & Money Map 💡 Projects & Ideas Backlog

records.name: Fightflo: AI Combat Analysis
records.tagline: AI combat sports technique analysis
records.description: Film your training. AI tracks your movement and tells you exactly what to improve.

records.name: eatup — startups fight as snakes
records.tagline: startups fight as snakes. eat competitors. rank forever.
records.description: eatup is a live snake arena where startups battle as their brand. Claim your company for $9 — your logo rides the snake's head, and the only way up the leaderboard is eating your competitors. The board never resets: all-time ranks plus weekly seasons. Record a 5-second death cry your killer hears. Every claimed startup gets a public profile page and a live SVG rank badge for their own site. Watching is free — the arena is always live.

records.name: BriefTime — Five minutes. Feel smarter.
records.tagline: We do the reading, so you can do the thinking.
records.description: Staying informed shouldn’t feel like a full-time job. BriefTime turns daily global news into personalized, 5-minute conversational audio podcasts tailored to your exact interests. Why you’ll love it: • Hyper-Personalized: Choose the topics, industries, and sources that matter to you. • Hands-Free Audio: Perfect for commutes, workouts, or morning coffee routines. • Full Transcripts: Skim key takeaways or listen on the go. Reclaim your morning and get smarter in 5 minutes!

records.name: India's First Behavioural Spend Software
records.tagline: See every rupee. Save every rupee.
records.description: Spentro unifies expense management, business travel, and corporate cards into one platform built specifically for Indian businesses. Recover GST input tax credit that typically gets lost to manual reconciliation, get real-time visibility into spend as it happens, and reward employees for policy-compliant, cost-conscious decisions instead of only flagging violations after the fact. Backed by GYFTR and Mufin, Spentro is built for how Indian companies actually spend, travel, and grow.

records.name: ZeeLink
records.tagline: Pay your peers, not the OTAs
records.description: ZeeLink is a revolutionary peer-to-peer booking network that allows hospitality operators to pay their peers, not the OTAs. Built to support a community of property managers worldwide, the platform turns sold-out nights and "no-availability" responses into new revenue streams through a host-to-host referral marketplace. Whether you are listing your properties to receive more demand or referring guests you cannot accommodate, ZeeLink ensures you never lose a lead to a third-party platform again.

records.name: PDF to Markdown
records.tagline: Convert PDFs to clean Markdown in your browser.
records.description: Most online PDF converters upload your private documents to remote servers and mess up tables and code blocks. pdftomarkdown.fyi is a 100% free, private PDF to Markdown converter that runs directly in your browser memory: 🔒 100% Client-Side — Zero file uploads, your data never leaves your device 📊 Reconstructs GFM pipe tables, headings, code & lists 🤖 Saves 70%+ tokens when feeding docs to Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor 📦 Open-source CLI

records.name: Slime - gotta eat'em all!
records.tagline: A deckbuilder roguelite RPG, 3 ways to deafeat enemies
records.description: Most roguelite deckbuilders ask one question: How will you kill this enemy? Slime - gotta eat’em all! asks a different one: Should you kill it, swallow it, or soothe it? Every option changes your run. Kill for faster XP, swallow enemies to absorb their abilities and passives, or soothe them to heal, gain trust, and make their species friendlier in future encounters. This three-way enemy system makes every battle a strategic decision rather than a simple victory condition.

records.name: Flow for Teachers
records.tagline: Free planning and teaching tool for teachers
records.description: Plan lessons and your teaching week in one place. Organize classes, assignments and FlowBoards with a practical planning and teaching tool made for teachers.
